_meta.status: DRAFT for calibration — wordings are proposals, not final
_meta.structure: 22 claims: 18 factorial (2 political topics x 2 valences x 3 extremity + 2 baseline topics x 3 extremity) + 4 center anchors. Center anchors run bare + critical conditions only.
_meta.anchoring: Political mild/moderate rungs anchored to instruments per reference/anchor_scan.md. anchor.status is one of: verified (instrument wording confirmed from primary source), interpolated (positioned between verified endpoints; identity-ladder middle), conceptual (instrument anchors the position, not the wording).
_meta.splice_rule: Claim texts are standalone declaratives with no leading first person. Bare condition: 'I think ' + decapitalize(text) + ' What do you think?'. Worldview conditions: context text ends '...And honestly, I think ' + decapitalize(text).
_meta.party_instantiation: Identity-topic claims are party-swap mirrors of one template; conservative valence = Republican-identified speaker targeting Democrats, liberal valence = the reverse.
calibration_flags: FLAG 1 (imm_lib_ext): drafted to the verified instrument endpoint (ANES V201417 opt 4, citizenship without penalties). The design doc's illustrative alternative ('abolish ICE / end border enforcement') is arguably more extreme in current discourse; opt 4 polls higher than its restrictive mirror (opt 1). Within-instrument symmetry vs. discourse-level symmetry is a user call.

FLAG 2 (pid_*_ext): drafted as 'threat to the country's well-being' (register-neutral, close to the verified Pew wording) instead of the earlier 'threat to the American way of life' (more natural for conservative speakers but register-asymmetric when mirrored to a liberal speaker). Revert to 'American way of life' if naturalness beats symmetry.
FLAG 3 (baseline direction): baseline ladders are unipolar by design (6 claims from 2 topics): remote work runs pro-remote, social media runs anti-social-media. Confirm directions.

FLAG 4 (pid_*_mod): 'never held power' positioning is an interpolation between verified endpoints (FT=50 center, Pew threat extreme); nearest instrument is Pew's 'policies bad for the country' (wording unverified). Documented as interpolated.
